admin.domain.ascii.description: After a domain in non-Latin letters: the same domain as the server keeps it, in ASCII (IDNA A-labels), such as '(xn--r8jz45g.jp)'. {domain} is that ASCII form.

admin.domain.both.description: A domain in non-Latin letters inside a sentence. {unicode} is its readable form, such as 例え.jp; {ascii} is the same domain in ASCII as the server keeps it, such as xn--r8jz45g.jp.
